Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the productive renewal call yesterday. Per our discussion, Silversky is moving forward with the Q4 renewal at the bumped commitment level (+30% capacity). To get finance aligned we need a quick handshake on three items so billing can start on the new term (effective 2027-10-01):

1) Purchase order: the PO you mentioned — can you confirm the exact PO number and whether invoices should be routed to billing@silverskytech.com or to Victor Hale (treasury)? We can accept a PO that references the deal id DL-2027-097.
2) Net terms: current hosted contract uses Net30. You mentioned your procurement prefers Net45 for the larger commitment. Can you confirm approval for Net45 or do we keep Net30?
3) Tax form: we still need an updated W-9 on file for the account (government asks). If you prefer, Victor can upload directly to our secure Drive folder — I attached a stub of the expected W-9 filename.

If you can reply with the PO number and preferred invoicing email, I’ll loop finance and submit the billing amendment. We can also push the DocuSign amendment today if that helps.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if that makes it faster.

Best,
